brief: Two bins to sort my dead AA batteries for recycling.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full; check_build ok, meshClash clear

Two open full-depth bins (~177x153 mm footprint, 80 mm deep) each fits many 50x14 mm AA cells; no battery props exist so shown empty for user to fill/sort (e.g. one bin per chemistry/brand). No material, electrical-safety or recycling-process claim.
requirements.requirement: Usable to sort dead AA batteries for recycling

finish.summary: Two side-by-side full-depth bins for sorting dead AAs. No battery props exist in the catalog so bins are left empty; capped and joint-locked, verified clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Two battery sorting bins — I'll build you a compact pair.
